---
name: Propose a project
about: Suggest an exhibition, artwork, grant, event, or other FF Utopia collaboration
title: "Project idea: "
---

## What future would this explore?
Describe the question, possibility, or practice you want to bring into the present. Other members do not have to agree with your entire vision.

## What might we make or do?
A work, exhibition, event, publication, public experiment, grant application, or other collaboration.

## What can you offer?
Skills, artwork, contacts, time, space, research, promotion, or something else. Be realistic; nothing here is a binding commitment.

## What help would be useful?
People, expertise, resources, critique, venue, funding, or visibility.

## First practical step
What small, reversible action could move this idea forward?

## Who decides and who gets credit?
Initial thoughts about participants, roles, authorship, and ownership. Agreements can be developed later and must be explicit before any binding financial or IP commitments.

## Open questions
What do we need to learn or test? What might go wrong?
